Landing.meta_title: WatchSync AI — AI-Powered Luxury Watch Inventory Management
Landing.meta_desc: AI-powered B2B SaaS platform for luxury watch dealers. Multi-channel inventory sync across eBay, Chrono24 and Shopify.
Landing.hero_desc: The operating system for serious watch dealers. List once, stay in sync everywhere across eBay, Chrono24 and Shopify. AI-graded photos, live market pricing, and zero double-sells.
Landing.features_desc: From AI-enhanced product photos to real-time market intelligence, WatchSync AI gives you an unfair advantage.
Landing.f1_desc: Automatically remove backgrounds, enhance quality, and generate studio-grade product photos using SAM 2 segmentation.
Landing.f2_desc: Seamlessly list and sync inventory across eBay, Chrono24, and Shopify with one click. Real-time stock updates.
Landing.f3_desc: Prevent double-selling with Redis-based mutex locks. Instant inventory state propagation across all channels.
Landing.f4_desc: Enterprise-grade concurrent access control ensures only one transaction processes per SKU at any given moment.
Landing.f5_desc: AI-driven price monitoring across Chrono24 and Watchfinder. Spot arbitrage opportunities before competitors.
Landing.f6_desc: Generate SEO-optimized, multi-language listing descriptions using fine-tuned LLMs with watch-specific knowledge.
Landing.cta_desc: Join luxury watch dealers who already manage their inventory with AI. Start streamlining your workflow today.
Landing.anatomy_desc: Every capability is a part of the same mechanism, machined to work as one. Nothing bolted on, nothing out of sync.
Landing.sync_desc: Stock, prices and status stay identical across every marketplace, updated the moment anything changes.
Landing.sync_hub_desc: A single source of truth with Redis-backed locking, so two channels can never sell the same watch.
Landing.trust_title: Engineered for the ones who can't afford mistakes.
Landing.trust_desc: High-value inventory needs infrastructure-grade guarantees, not marketing promises.
Landing.trust_point1_d: Per-SKU mutex locking means only one transaction touches a watch at a time. The race condition simply can't happen.
Landing.trust_point2_d: Inventory state propagates across every channel almost instantly, so your listings never contradict each other.
Landing.trust_point3_d: Reconciliation runs continuously and self-heals drift, keeping every marketplace in agreement.
Landing.beat2_line: AI processes the photo, grades the condition, writes the listing.
Landing.beat3_line: List once; eBay, Chrono24 and Shopify never drift apart.
Landing.beat4_line: One lock per SKU: only one transaction can touch a watch.
Landing.manifesto_1: A luxury watch is a machine of a thousand parts working as one.
Landing.manifesto_2: Your inventory should run the same way.
Landing.how_title: List once. The rest is automatic.
Landing.step1_d: Add a watch once. AI removes the background, grades the photos and drafts the listing copy.
Landing.step2_d: Push it live to eBay, Chrono24 and Shopify in one move, with stock and pricing kept identical.
Landing.step3_d: The moment one channel sells, every other listing updates instantly. No double-sells, no cleanup.
Landing.prod_desc: No concept art — real screens from WatchSync. Inventory, channels and sync status at a glance.
Landing.prod_shot1_d: Inventory value, active watches and the sync feed in real time.
Landing.prod_shot2_d: Every watch with status, price and channel badges for eBay · Chrono24 · Shopify.
Landing.pricing_desc: A fixed monthly price per dealer account. We don't take a cut of your sales.
Landing.plan1_f5: Team seats with roles and permissions
Landing.faq1_q: How do I connect eBay, Chrono24 and Shopify?
Landing.faq1_a: You sign in to each channel once in Settings. Connecting takes a few minutes; from then on WatchSync keeps stock and prices in sync automatically.
Landing.faq2_q: What happens if a watch sells on two channels at once?
Landing.faq2_a: It can't. The moment a purchase starts, the watch is locked on every other channel instantly. There is only ever one valid sale.
Landing.faq3_a: Yes. All connections are encrypted, access is role-based, and your data is never shared with third parties.
Landing.faq4_a: Yes, monthly cancellation. The trial ends automatically — you pay nothing if you decide against it.
Landing.faq5_q: Do you take a commission per sale?
Landing.faq5_a: No. You pay a fixed monthly price, no matter how much you sell.

eBay.title: eBay Connection Guide
eBay.s1_desc: Sign up for the eBay Developer Program and create an application. Select Sandbox or Production environment.
eBay.s2_desc: Create a new application under 'Create Application' on the Developer Dashboard. Select 'Trading API' as the Application Type.
eBay.s3_desc: Enter WatchSync AI's callback URL as the OAuth Redirect URI in the application settings. This is automatically configured in the settings page.
eBay.s4_desc: Click the connect button on the platform card. The eBay authorization page will open and request account authorization.
eBay.s5_desc: Test in the Sandbox environment first. Create test watches and check sync. Move to Production when everything is working.
eBay.t1: OAuth tokens are refreshed automatically, no manual intervention is needed.
eBay.t2: eBay API call limits apply — 5,000 calls per day (Production).
eBay.t3: Listings go through eBay's approval process, which can take up to 24 hours.

Chrono24.title: Chrono24 Connection Guide
Chrono24.s1_desc: You need a professional dealer account on Chrono24. Apply if you don't have one yet.
Chrono24.s2_desc: Contact Chrono24 customer support to request API access. You will be provided with an API key and secret.
Chrono24.s3_desc: Report your server IP address to Chrono24. Chrono24 pulls your XML feed only from IP addresses in the whitelist.
Chrono24.s4_desc: Enter the API key and secret you received into the form on the platform card and save.
Chrono24.s5_desc: WatchSync AI automatically creates an XML feed. Send the feed URL to Chrono24 support team. The feed will be pulled periodically.
Chrono24.t1: Chrono24 XML feed is usually pulled 2-4 times a day.
Chrono24.t2: Prices must be in EUR — WatchSync AI performs automatic conversion.
Chrono24.t3: Use high-quality images — Chrono24 requires a minimum of 640x480px.
Chrono24.t4: You can check your XML output with the feed preview link.

Shopify.title: Shopify Connection Guide
Shopify.s1_title: 1. Log In to Your Shopify Store
Shopify.s1_desc: Log in to the Shopify Admin panel. Go to Settings → Apps and sales channels.
Shopify.s2_desc: Create a new custom app via 'Develop apps' → 'Create an app'. Name the app 'WatchSync AI'.
Shopify.s3_desc: Select the following scopes in Configuration → Admin API integration: read_products, write_products, read_inventory, write_inventory.
Shopify.s4_desc: 'Install' the app. Copy the Admin API access token, API key, and secret from the API Credentials tab.
Shopify.s5_desc: Click the 'Enter API Key' button on the platform card. Enter the Shopify API key and secret, then save.
Shopify.t1: Shopify access token is shown once — store it in a secure place.
Shopify.t2: Your store domain must be in format: yourstore.myshopify.com.
Shopify.t3: Inventory synchronization works with real-time webhooks.
Shopify.t4: Daily API call limit without Shopify Plus: 40 requests/second.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Information in accordance with the GDPR and EU data protection standards
Privacy.s1_body: The entity responsible for data processing on this website and within the WatchSync AI software service is: WatchSync AI Technologies GmbH, Königsallee 60, 40212 Düsseldorf, email: privacy@watchsync.ai. Further details can be found in our imprint.
Privacy.s2_title: Data processed and purposes of collection
Privacy.s2_body: To deliver the WatchSync AI services we process account data (name, email, company name), inventory data (watch brand/model, prices), payment data (processed securely via Stripe) and technical access logs (IP address, timestamp).
Privacy.s3_title: Marketplace and API integrations (Stripe, eBay, Chrono24, Shopify)
Privacy.s3_body: Once you connect an eBay, Chrono24, Shopify or Stripe integration, inventory as well as subscription and payment data is transferred via those platforms' secured APIs. Card data is never stored on our servers; it is held by Stripe Inc. in line with PCI-DSS standards.
Privacy.s4_body: Processing is carried out pursuant to Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of a contract), (c) (legal obligations) and (f) (legitimate interest — security and fraud prevention).
Privacy.s5_body: User data is retained for the duration of the subscription and for the statutory tax and commercial retention periods (6–10 years under the German HGB/AO). Data belonging to cancelled accounts is permanently anonymised or deleted once those periods expire.
Privacy.s6_body: As a data subject you have the right to access, rectification, erasure (the 'right to be forgotten'), restriction of processing, data portability and objection. Please send requests to privacy@watchsync.ai.
Privacy.s7_body: For details on subscription plans, commission rates (3%, capped at €150) and cancellation rights, please see our Terms of Service.

Terms.title: General Terms and Service Agreement
Terms.meta_description: WatchSync AI general terms, conditions of use, commission and subscription agreement.
Terms.last_updated: Last updated: {date} — B2B customer and user agreement
Terms.s1_title: Scope and definition of the parties
Terms.s1_body: This B2B service agreement and set of general terms (the "Terms") governs the relationship between WatchSync AI (the "Company" or "Service Provider") and the luxury watch dealers, sellers and galleries registered on the platform (the "User" or "Customer"). WatchSync AI is not a consumer marketplace but multi-platform inventory and stock synchronisation software (B2B SaaS).
Terms.s2_title: Description of the service and inventory synchronisation
Terms.s2_body: WatchSync AI lets the User manage their watch inventory from a single dashboard, process images to studio quality using artificial intelligence (SAM 2), generate content, and synchronise that data with third-party marketplaces (eBay, Chrono24, Shopify and others). Locking mechanisms (Redis mutex) are used to help prevent stock conflicts.
Terms.s3_body:
3.1. Subscription plans: The User pays the chosen monthly or annual plan fee (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) in advance via Stripe.
3.2. Per-sale commission: For sales completed through the multi-platform integration, a 3% platform transaction commission applies unless the plan states otherwise.
3.3. Cap protection: Commission per sale is capped at a maximum of €150 / $150 for any single watch. However high the sale price, the commission payable on one watch cannot exceed that amount.
3.4. Direct payment link commission: Sales made through payment links generated within WatchSync are subject to a 1.5% processing fee.
Terms.s4_body: The User may cancel the subscription at any time via Dashboard > Subscription & Billing or by notifying customer support. Service is not cut off immediately: the User retains full access to all platform features until the end of the billing period already paid for. At the end of that period the subscription does not renew and access ends. No retroactive refunds are issued.
Terms.s5_title: Limitation of liability and double-sale disclosure
Terms.s5_body: WatchSync AI uses highly available locking mechanisms (Redis mutex) to prevent concurrent sale conflicts. However, for losses arising from double sales caused by the User's internet outages, third-party marketplace API failures (eBay, Chrono24, Shopify), API quota limits or the User's own manual stock errors, WatchSync AI's maximum liability is limited to the total subscription fee paid by the User in the preceding month. The User is responsible for verifying the accuracy of their listings published on the marketplaces.
Terms.s6_body: Product images and data uploaded by the User remain the User's property. The User grants permission for that data to be processed in order to run the AI models and deliver the service. The Service Provider undertakes to protect the data in line with GDPR standards.
Terms.s7_body: Disputes arising from this agreement are governed by the law of the Federal Republic of Germany. This agreement is B2B (commercial) in nature and the courts at the Service Provider's registered seat have jurisdiction.
Terms.notice_body: All users who register on the WatchSync AI platform and tick the acceptance box are deemed to have read and accepted the terms above, the subscription renewal rules and the commission/cap rules.
